issue_request: FHIR-19573 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R request to allow ResearchStudy to represent a study site as an Organization, noting that sites are often identified by the organization providing the location rather than by a physical Location alone.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-19573. The same substantive Organization-reference change was applied through FHIR-23064 in commit 9175459a6ea354d82e8b09ca90574344bbe333d6, which added Organization as a targetProfile on ResearchStudy.site.
additional_context: ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition defines ResearchStudy.site as Reference(Location, ResearchStudy, Organization). The exact related FHIR-23064 issue is already represented on the combined branch, FHIR-19574 rejected creating a separate ResearchSite resource, and later ResearchStudySite/profile discussion did not reverse the core Organization target.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative ResearchStudy StructureDefinition already implements the requested Organization target and a separate source edit for FHIR-19573 would duplicate the existing applied state.
